Logical partitions require fastbootd; flash resolves the current slot, validates expanded image size, resizes the logical partition and verifies capacity before writing. Large raw/sparse images are split automatically. A failed flash stops immediately; incomplete partitions are remembered before reboot. For another slot, specify its exact partition name (for example system_b). wipe-super and host filesystem format stay disabled until their required host metadata/filesystem engines are bundled."

V6 Firmware Upgrade runs one SP Flash Tool-style FLASH-UPDATE 2.0 transaction. It validates the immutable plan, layout, image size/timestamp, protected backup paths, and the resulting partition table. Runtime image checksum is disabled (NONE); structural and transport safety checks remain enabled. Auto Relock is applied only after postflight succeeds. This does not bypass anti-rollback."
